A '''drone truck''' was an automated vehicle that could be operated remotely. In [[Montrol City]] on [[Gandle Ott]], drone trucks were controlled by the [[BRT supercomputer/Legends|BRT supercomputer]] [[CUTH-BRT-92-X3]].
